name: B360 Cache & Optimize
author: brijesh7191

sections.description:
B360 Cache & Optimize is a fast, lightweight WordPress performance and caching plugin that helps you speed up your website, improve your Google PageSpeed score, and pass Core Web Vitals – all from one clean admin screen. No coding, no paid account, and no product key required.

Slow websites lose visitors, rankings, and sales. B360 Cache & Optimize tackles the most common speed problems on WordPress: heavy pages with no caching, render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, unoptimized images, and a bloated database. Turn on the features you need and watch your load time drop.

Whether you run a blog, business site, portfolio, or WooCommerce-ready store, B360 Cache & Optimize gives you the essential speed optimization tools that usually cost money – completely free.

Why choose B360 Cache & Optimize?

  • 100% free – every feature in this WordPress.org build works without a license, trial, or quota.
  • Beginner friendly – simple toggles with clear descriptions, plus a one-click Safe Mode if anything looks off.
  • Lightweight – built with a modern, modular codebase that only loads what you enable.
  • No external service – your site data stays on your server; nothing is sent to a remote account.
  • Built for Core Web Vitals – targets LCP, FCP, and TBT directly.

Page Caching

  • Static HTML page cache for blazing-fast page delivery
  • Dedicated mobile device caching
  • Optional caching for logged-in users
  • Cache preloading / warm-up so the first visitor gets a cached page
  • Automatic cache purge when you publish or update content
  • Scheduled cache cleanup with a configurable cache lifespan

CSS & JavaScript Optimization (File Optimization)

  • Minify CSS – strip comments and whitespace
  • Combine CSS files into fewer requests
  • Combine inline CSS into the combined file
  • Minify JavaScript (safely skips sliders, carousels, loaders, and already-minified libraries)
  • Defer JavaScript to remove render-blocking scripts
  • Minify HTML output
  • Remove unused WordPress core inline styles (emoji styles, classic theme styles, global styles)

Core Web Vitals & PageSpeed

  • Inline Critical CSS for faster First Contentful Paint
  • LCP image preload with high fetch priority for a better Largest Contentful Paint
  • Heartbeat Control to reduce admin AJAX load and Total Blocking Time

Media Optimization

  • Lazy load images as they enter the viewport
  • Lazy load iframes and embedded videos
  • WebP image conversion (via Imagick or GD) to serve smaller next-gen images

Database Cleanup

  • Delete post revisions
  • Remove auto-drafts and trashed posts
  • Optimize database tables
  • Clear plugin logs
  • Detect and safely remove orphaned tables left behind by uninstalled plugins

Server-Level Optimization

  • Enable Gzip compression via .htaccess
  • Add browser caching (Expires headers) for static assets

Advanced Cache Control

  • Never cache specific URLs
  • Never cache when specific cookies are present
  • Exclude specific user agents from caching
  • Allow caching for selected query strings
  • Always purge selected URLs on content updates
  • Exclude assets from specific plugins

Extras

  • Built-in Elementor optimization tweaks
  • Export, import, and reset your settings as JSON
  • Safe Mode to temporarily disable risky optimizations while you troubleshoot

Third Party Services

Privacy Policy: https://b360cacheoptimize.online/privacy-policy/

This plugin does not send requests to, or require an account with, any external service for the features included in the WordPress.org package. All optimization is performed on your own server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the b360-cache-optimize folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate B360 Cache & Optimize from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the B360 Cache & Optimize menu in your WordPress admin.
  4. Enable Static Cache Engine under Cache Settings to start page caching.
  5. Turn on the File Optimization, Media, and Database features you need, then click Save Settings.

Tip: If your theme or another plugin looks broken after enabling optimizations, switch on Safe Mode from the Dashboard, then re-enable features one at a time to find the cause.
sections.faq:
Does B360 Cache & Optimize require a paid account or license?

No. Every feature in this WordPress.org build works for free without a license key, trial, or paid account.

Will this plugin speed up my WordPress site?

Yes. Page caching, CSS/JS minification, lazy loading, WebP images, and database cleanup all reduce load time and can improve your Google PageSpeed and Core Web Vitals scores.

Does it help with Core Web Vitals (LCP, FCP, TBT)?

Yes. Critical CSS and LCP image preloading target FCP and LCP, lazy loading reduces initial payload, and Heartbeat Control helps lower Total Blocking Time.

Is it compatible with my theme and page builders like Elementor?

B360 Cache & Optimize works with standard WordPress themes and includes optional Elementor optimization tweaks. If you ever see a display issue, enable Safe Mode and re-test.

Does the plugin connect to any external service?

No. The features in this WordPress.org package do not require a remote account or external service. Your data stays on your server.

How do I clear the cache?

Use the Cache Actions menu at the top of the plugin screen to purge all cache or clear specific caches. Cache is also purged automatically when you publish or update content.

Something looks broken after enabling optimizations. What do I do?

Turn on Safe Mode from the Dashboard. It temporarily disables the riskier optimizations (such as Combine CSS and JavaScript handling) while keeping page cache, lazy load, and WebP running, so you can pinpoint the setting that caused the issue.

Does WebP conversion need anything special?

WebP conversion uses the Imagick or GD PHP extension with WebP support. If neither is available on your host, the WebP toggle stays disabled and the plugin tells you which extension is missing.

Is it safe to remove orphaned database tables?

The Database screen clearly marks tables as Core, Active, or Not In Use. Only tables flagged as “Not In Use” (left behind by uninstalled plugins) are suggested for removal. Always keep a backup before cleaning your database.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Initial release of B360 Cache & Optimize.
  • Static page cache with mobile and logged-in user caching, preloading, and automatic purge.
  • CSS and JavaScript minification, CSS combining, HTML minification, and WordPress inline styles cleanup.
  • Critical CSS, LCP image preloading, and Heartbeat Control for Core Web Vitals.
  • Lazy loading for images and iframes plus WebP image conversion.
  • Database cleanup with orphaned table detection.
  • Gzip and browser caching via .htaccess, advanced cache exclusions, Elementor tweaks, and settings import/export.
